subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should OpenClaw expose blocked Telegram and WhatsApp DM content to trusted pre-auth hooks and permit trusted access-request hook auto-loading, after the grouping work is rebased onto the canonical `accessGroups` contract?
rationale: Code review can identify the duplicate contract and implementation risks, but only maintainers can authorize a new pre-admission privacy boundary and activation default for existing allowlist installations.

options.title: Narrow And Rebase
options.body: Keep the pre-auth workflow, replace channel-local fixed groups with canonical `accessGroups`, and require focused upgrade and security proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Full Boundary
options.body: Approve the pre-auth exposure and automatic trusted-hook activation as product contracts, while still requiring the grouping duplication to be resolved.

options.title: Pause The Feature
options.body: Close or park the PR if core should not expose blocked content or auto-activate trusted access-request handling.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the pre-auth workflow, replace channel-local fixed groups with canonical `accessGroups`, and require focused upgrade and security proof before merge.
